source: synthetic; authored by Codex from S1 specification; no pilot or production data
label_status: machine-authored expectations; independent human review pending

cases.name: shared_interests
cases.criterion: Shared music events should lead unrelated options; categories remain soft.

cases.name: opposite_interests
cases.criterion: A compromise should beat an option with zero fit for one participant.

cases.name: zero_history_both
cases.criterion: Explicit room choices are the only personal signals; absent history is neutral.

cases.name: zero_history_one
cases.criterion: Current shared music intent takes priority over conflicting saved profile.

cases.name: conflicting_profiles
cases.criterion: Room music intent should remain relevant despite both saved cinema profiles.

cases.name: asymmetric_budget
cases.criterion: Known price must fit min(A,B); null remains unknown.

cases.name: raised_other_budget
cases.criterion: Raising only B cannot admit an event over A budget.

cases.name: unknown_price
cases.criterion: Unknown price is eligible but is neither free nor confirmed within budget.

cases.name: all_unknown_price
cases.criterion: Do not silently discard an entire unknown-price catalog.

cases.name: concentrated_category
cases.criterion: Category discovery must be measured against loss of shared music relevance.

cases.name: pool_0
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(0,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_1
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(1,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_2
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(2,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_20
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(20,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_21
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(21,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_22
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(22,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_23
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(23,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_24
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(24,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: pool_30
cases.criterion: Keep exactly min(30,24) events; IsSmall only for 1 or 2.

cases.name: repeat_round_2
cases.criterion: Previously served event IDs must be absent in round two.

cases.name: repeat_round_3
cases.criterion: Round three still excludes every previous event ID.

cases.name: distinct_sessions
cases.criterion: Different stable provider event identities remain separate.

cases.name: same_series
cases.criterion: Verified identical provider identity collapses to earliest eligible occurrence.

cases.name: expired_time
cases.criterion: An event before or exactly at fixed now must be excluded.

cases.name: zero_date_overlap
cases.criterion: No shared local date means zero candidates; do not expose peer dates.

cases.name: zero_slot_overlap
cases.criterion: Disjoint requested time slots mean zero candidates.

cases.name: secondary_categories
cases.criterion: Music on a secondary category is relevant; do not use primary-only fit.

cases.name: soft_category_only
cases.criterion: A category change never creates eligibility; unrelated valid events remain eligible.

cases.name: ticket_status
cases.criterion: Cancelled, unavailable-ticket and demo events must never be served.

cases.name: venue_exclusion
cases.criterion: Participant nightclub exclusion applies to both; venue cap may relax on shortage.

cases.name: sparse_behavior
cases.criterion: One or two votes should not overrule shared room preferences.

cases.name: established_behavior
cases.criterion: History is measured separately from explicit room intent.
